name: imobiliaria-ai
description: Offices AI Imobiliária — plataforma SaaS multi-tenant para imobiliárias com camada de agentes de IA (AaaS)

scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.images:build: docker build -f backend/Dockerfile -t ${BACKEND_IMAGE:-offices-ai/backend:latest} . && docker build -f frontend/Dockerfile --build-arg NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=$NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY -t ${FRONTEND_IMAGE:-offices-ai/frontend:latest} .
